_comment: ACT per-role config. Move to ~/.act.json (NOT repo root). Each agent specifies a provider (key under "providers") and a model string passed verbatim to the upstream API. ACT does not maintain a list of supported models — type the upstream identifier as-is. A provider is automatically usable once apiKey is filled in (or for local, when the endpoint responds); no explicit enable flag.

groq._comment: Free tier with Llama 3.3 70B is great for swarm. Get a key at https://console.groq.com

openrouter._comment: Aggregator with many free models. Get a key at https://openrouter.ai

local._comment: OpenAI-compatible local endpoint. baseURL points at LM Studio (default), Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1), vLLM, etc. apiKey is usually empty for local.

agents._comment: Tier 1 = Planner / Observer / Assurance / QA. Tier 2 = swarm developer / frontend_dev / backend_dev / qa_engineer / researcher.
agents._comment_acp: ALPHA OPTION — back Tier 1 with Claude Code via ACP instead of free-tier LLMs. Replace provider/model on each Tier 1 role with: "backend": "acp", "acp": {"host": "claude-code"}. Requires Node.js so `npx` can fetch @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp on first launch. Uses your Claude Code subscription — no API tokens spent here. Toggle from the TUI any time with /backend <role> acp (or /backend all acp).

planner._comment: Most important model. Project decomposition + task creation + context engineering for swarm agents. Don't skimp.

observer._comment: Watchdog. Monitors swarm and Tier 1 agent activity. Identifies anomalies, conflicts, bottlenecks, hung agents, etc.

assurance._comment: Validates that swarm-completed tasks meet @success_criteria + @constraints with tools. Passes only when all criteria are >=95% met.

qa_synthesizer._comment: Only accepts tasks that pass assurance. Assembles validated work into the final deliverable.

developer._comment: Default swarm role. Multiple instances each retain their own context — all handled by ACT.
developer._comment_backend: If backend is set to claude-code, leave provider+model empty and ACT uses your Claude Code subscription (no API tokens spent, no token spoofing).
